# Get current state before probing top red
seg = current_frame.segmentation
current_blocks = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 4 and n['color'] not in ['B', 'N', 'G', 'c', 'R']:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        current_blocks[(min_r, min_c)] = n['color']

# Click the top red entity at (16, 19)
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 18, 'col': 21}])

# Get new state

        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        new_blocks[(min_r, min_c)] = n['color']

print("Changes after clicking top red entity:")
for pos in sorted(set(list(current_blocks.keys()) + list(new_blocks.keys()))):
    before = current_blocks.get(pos, '?')
    after = new_blocks.get(pos, '?')
    if before != after:
        print(f"  {pos}: {before} -> {after}")
